In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name…

translations.web: But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”
translations.bsb: But if I am doing them, even though you do not believe Me, believe the works themselves, so that you may know and understand that the Father is in Me, and I am in the Father.”
translations.kjv: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.
translations.asv: But if I do them, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know and understand that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.
